text:
tim: Opening a short tracker for the streaming/connectivity follow-ups from the postmortem. Goal: list owners, short ETAs, and a weekly checkpoint here.

maria: I'll own reconnect-state debugging + short-term server mitigant. Plan: reproduce sticky session locally, add extra state validation, and sketch rollout. ETA: 2026-04-05. HF-4310.

alex: i'll take the partial-response side: add dedup on partial ACKs, introduce a 200ms grace window before KV eviction, and a fallback to small-batch non-stream if we detect eviction thrash. ETA: 2026-04-12. HF-4311.

ryan: product asks for a customer impact note and an SDK opt-in toggle if we change session semantics. i'll draft language and coordinate with devex. ETA: 2026-04-07. HF-4314.

sre-lead: will deploy a temporary rate-shedding canary in us/eu that caps concurrent streaming per-node and enforces jittered reconnect backoff (1-3s). Canary window: 2026-03-28 -> 2026-03-30. HF-4312.

oncall-bot: Reminder: add HF IDs to messages. Weekly auto-check scheduled in 7 days.

maria: repro log excerpt — client sends duplicate partial ACK, server treats as final, then kv eviction: \n```\n2026-03-21T09:06:12Z STREAM node=gs-07 event=partial_ack seq=118 session=xyz789\n2026-03-21T09:06:13Z STREAM node=gs-07 event=partial_ack seq=118 session=xyz789\n2026-03-21T09:06:13Z KVCACHE node=gs-07 action=evict session=xyz789 reason=dup_ack\n```\nSuggest: detect duplicate seq within 250ms window and defer eviction.

alex: added a unit test for duplicate partial ACKs and a 250ms grace in my branch. PR coming (HF-4311). Early bench shows eviction count drops ~84% in synthetic burst.

devex: about the SDK toggle — recommend a runtime flag `streaming_session_strict=true|false` and note in migration doc. i'll add a snippet to SDK README and a short migration guide. HF-4315.

qa: i'll run a focused e2e with flaky network emulation for the canary config and validate rollback triggers. ETA: 2026-03-29. HF-4313.

ryan: customer-facing draft (short): "We're rolling a fix to improve streaming stability in high-burst scenarios. You can opt into the new session semantics via the SDK toggle; we'll default to opt-out for 30 days while we monitor." Will post PR for review. HF-4314.

sre-lead: monitoring: charting token-drop-rate and partial-response-rate by region/model. Rollback rule: if token-drop-rate increases >0.5% above baseline for 3 consecutive 10m windows, automatic rollback. Canary start 2026-03-28 08:00 UTC.

oncall-bot: HF tasks created: HF-4310, HF-4311, HF-4312, HF-4313, HF-4314, HF-4315.

tim: good coverage. two asks before we close this loop: (1) alex — a 90-day trend query by region/model/seq-len to confirm recurrence buckets, paste results here; (2) maria — confirm if server change is hot-reloadable or will require a coordinated deploy.

alex: running query now; initial result: spikes in eu-west and us-east, 3x higher for requests with seq > 2048, and concentrated on `redwood-model-v1-legacy` and `community-llama-13b-v2`. Posting table in HF-4311 comment.

maria: server change requires a restart of the stream-agent on nodes (no full infra change). we'll stage a rolling restart during the canary window. HF-4310 notes updated.

ryan: note for comms — if rolling restart impacts persistent session tokens we must warn customers 48h in advance. adding to draft.

sre-lead: canary config pushed to staging. QA to validate, then promote to eu-west subset. Rolling restart plan included in runbook.

oncall-bot: Weekly check-in scheduled in 7 days. Please post short status updates with HF prefix.

tim: i'll run the first 15-min sync tomorrow and keep this thread as the single remediation tracker. Start messages with HF- for automation. Thanks.
